collection.name: studs
collection.doc: Headed shear stud of a composite beam (EN 1994-1-1 6.6): one row per stud with its position along the beam and its dimensions.

fields.name: beam_id
fields.doc: 🔗 Id of the composite beam the stud belongs to.

fields.name: x_m
fields.doc: ↔️ Position x [m] of the stud along the beam axis, measured from the start of the beam (the first support of its span layout).

fields.name: f_u_pa
fields.doc: 💪 Specified ultimate tensile strength f_u [Pa], at most 500 MPa.
